prompt:
Desktop web UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, of Marketo's full program page. Same visual world as the reference: warm newsprint paper #e6d8c6 with fiber grain, carbon ink #040303, extra-condensed athletic gothic for names, Barlow Condensed agate labels, 3px solid black rules, square-cut everything, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glass. BTC silks red #e42c22 square; ETH silks blue #0756d0 square. Purse green #085324 for money only. This is a designed website form, not a racetrack photo, not a poster.

The reference supplies palette, type, rules, silks squares, and stamp character. Do NOT copy the reference layout (no giant WARDEN owning the fold, no three-horse strip across the bottom).

STRUCTURE: (1) Thin masthead ~8% height: MARKETO left; date; dreamDEX line; EN/ID; ENTER A HORSE. (2) Below a 3px ink rule, TWO regions like a newspaper spread. (3) LEFT ~45%: filter chips ACTIVE/INACTIVE/AGE/PNL/TVL as invert rectangles, then stacked program entries like racing-form rows — number, silks, name, one past-performance line, green purse, status. Horses: WARDEN, KITE, REDLINE, ASH. WARDEN row has 8% ink wash as selected. (4) RIGHT ~55% overlay: a two-page mini condition book on 55% Hot Sheet wash #f3eadc, split by a 3px vertical ink gutter. Left page of the overlay: past-performance table, ruled TVL progress bar filling toward MAX, last backer deposit/withdraw line, SYNTHETIC tags. Right page of the overlay: boxed title BACK THIS HORSE, amount underline, + chips, green rubber-stamp DEPOSIT. (5) This is the program with a horse opened, not the /enter nomination form.

Visitor job (pick a horse from the program, then deposit on the book) must be readable from the image alone. No neon, no Inter, no testimonials.
